Revenue growth of 6.4% is steady and recurring (subscription model). The stock was above $389 less than a year ago; it has re-rated to a level that prices in very modest growth expectations, creating asymmetry. EPS revisions are modestly positive (+1.6%). TECHNICAL: At only 37% of its 52-week range ($188-$390), this is the ideal basing entry zone. SMA50 slope has inflected sharply positive (+6.3% over 20 days), price is +7% above both SMA50 and SMA200 — early Stage 2 breakout from a lengthy base, not an extended late-cycle entry. ATR-based stop of 1.75x (~$22 below entry) gives a natural stop at ~$241 (8.4%), well within the 4-15% allowable range. Position sizing: 68 shares × $263 = $17,878 (17.7% of equity — below 25% cap); worst-case stop hit = $1,501 = 1.48% of equity — within the 1-2% risk budget. PRIOR TRACK RECORD: Two prior FDS trades in this book closed at +17.97% and +11.51% — the thesis has been repeatedly validated.
